description: Zero trust architecture principles are not implemented in the security design. This signal indicates that implicit trust may be granted based on network location rather than continuous verification.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments moving toward zero trust. Includes micro-segmentation, continuous authentication, and least-privilege access verification.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through architecture review, zero trust maturity assessment, and continuous verification testing.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
